newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico predicts tax reveunes up five pct in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Mexico predicts tax reveunes up five pct in 1997.

text.p: Mexico hopes to reverse years of tax evasion and expects tax revenues in 1997 to increase by five percent in real terms from 1996, a Finance Ministry (Hacienda) official told reporters on Wednesday.

"The Revenue Law envisages real growth in collected taxes of five percent in 1997 compared to 1996. This target has been more than reached in the first quarter, when revenue grew by 12 percent," said Deputy Minister for Revenue at Hacienda, Tomas Ruiz,
Ruiz said tax evasion reached a peak in Mexico in 1995 and the beginning of 1996 in the wake of an economic crisis.
Evasion of value-added tax alone stood at 35 percent, Ruiz added.
